uncovered_shapes.sentence: Post-fire surveys at Bontebok recorded the progressive loss of slow-maturing seed-regenerating shrubs, including Protea repens, once the shortened cycle became established.

A 2021 analysis across multiple protea populations derived conservative minimum intervals of 11–14 years when the 50 percent flowering-for-three-seasons rule was applied to the slowest-maturing stands.
